stem: A 16-year-old boy has had 6 months of hand tremor, slurred speech and declining school performance. Slit-lamp examination shows golden-brown rings at the corneal limbus. ALT is mildly elevated, and serum ceruloplasmin and total serum copper are low while 24-hour urinary copper is high.
oneliner: 16M + tremor, slurred speech, falling school performance + corneal limbal rings + low ceruloplasmin + high urinary copper → best drug?
ask: Which of the following is the most appropriate pharmacotherapy?

whyNot.B: **Deferoxamine**: iron chelator for iron overload; copper is the problem here
whyNot.C: **Dimercaprol (BAL)**: arsenic, mercury, gold and lead poisoning
whyNot.E: **EDTA**: lead poisoning; not for copper overload

answer: Penicillamine (copper chelator; trientine and zinc are alternatives)
why: **Tremor, dysarthria, Kayser-Fleischer rings, low ceruloplasmin and high urinary copper** = Wilson disease. **Penicillamine** chelates copper and increases its urinary excretion.

drug.name: Penicillamine
drug.watch: Nephrotic syndrome, lupus-like reaction, hypersensitivity, worsens neurologic symptoms early

stem: A 5-month-old boy has had seizures, poor head control and an ataxic gait. He has patchy hair loss and a scaly red rash around the mouth and eyes. Blood gas shows metabolic acidosis with elevated lactate, and urine organic acid analysis shows several abnormal metabolites. His diet is normal and he has not received antibiotics.
oneliner: 5-month-old boy + seizures, hypotonia, ataxia + hair loss, perioral scaly rash + lactic acidosis + abnormal urine organic acids → best supplement?
ask: Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment?

whyNot.A: **Riboflavin**: for flavoprotein defects; does not explain alopecia and dermatitis
whyNot.B: **Pyridoxine**: for pyridoxine-dependent seizures, which lack the rash, alopecia and organic aciduria
whyNot.C: **Cobalamin**: for methylmalonic and megaloblastic disorders; not this rash and hair loss
whyNot.D: **Thiamine**: for pyruvate dehydrogenase deficiency or beriberi; no alopecia or dermatitis

why: **Seizures, hypotonia, alopecia, perioral dermatitis and organic aciduria** = multiple carboxylase deficiency (biotinidase or holocarboxylase synthetase defect). **Biotin** supplements restore carboxylase activity.

drug.name: Biotin (vitamin B7)
drug.how: Cofactor for carboxylases (pyruvate, acetyl-CoA, propionyl-CoA carboxylase)
drug.watch: Very safe; raw egg white (avidin) causes deficiency
